grades.quote: Current global interrupt enable bit, which is active high. When an exception is triggered, the hardware sets the value of this field to 0, to ensure that the interrupt is masked when caught.
grades.reason: Describes CRMD.IE as the current global interrupt enable bit. It is cleared on exception entry so interrupts are masked, and it is restored on ERTN. This covers the CRMD.IE part of the query. It does not mention ECFG or ESTAT or how they combine with IE.

grades.quote: The timer interrupt is recorded by the processor core in the `CSR.ESTA.IS[11]` bit.
grades.reason: Explains that line-based interrupts are recorded as pending in the CSR.ESTA.IS bits, which is the ESTAT side of the query. It does not cover ECFG local enables or CRMD.IE gating, so it does not explain how delivery is allowed or blocked.
Covers message interrupts recorded in CSR.MSGIS0-3. The query asks about line-based interrupts controlled by CRMD.IE, ECFG and ESTAT, so this does not help.
